title: The rotations
html:
orchestration/tools/healers/paladin_holy_requests.py writes both presets from one set of knobs, and a variant with --out FILE --set key=value; each variant was benched against the default, 500 iterations, the -carry score (the damage carried at the death line), the bench's healer reaction time and cancelling. A carry moves about ±0.01 to 0.02 between seeds at 500 iterations; a difference under that is noise.

Tank healer (one healer on the tanks, the files' own tank time, and Onyxia at 180 and 300 sec)

The first rotation: Oath of Light on the tank, Divine Favor before a Holy Light 9 the tank misses, Holy Light 9, 8 and 7 at the tank, Flash of Light 6 at the most hurt, Holy Shock under 50% health, Flash of Light under 35%, Lay on Hands under 10%. Carry, against it (each variant changes one knob):

  • Oath of Light is worth 0.03 to 0.04 on Onyxia and Ragnaros at their lengths and 0.07 to 0.12 at 180 and 300 sec; on the short Broodlord and Magmadar stints its global cooldown at the pull costs a little.
  • Concentration Aura changes nothing in the tank role: the boss never hits the healer.
  • Human is the race: 0.02 to 0.05 ahead of Dwarf and Undead at 300 sec (The Human Spirit's 10% Spirit).

Raid healer (one healer on the raid's assignment, the files' raid time)

The raid healer is the tank healer without the Oath, with every heal at the most hurt. Each variant against it, 500 iterations: Holy Shock at the most hurt whenever it misses what Holy Shock heals, the Vigil on our party, ranks out at 80% of their size, Flash of Light 6, 5 and 4, Holy Light 9, 7 and 5. None was ahead past noise (Onyxia 0.714 the base and the best; Broodlord 0.831 for Flash of Light 6, 5 and 4 and 0.822 for the Vigil against 0.815; Vaelastrasz 1.008 for the Vigil against 0.996). Talents

The preset build, 53320015002101251-5-052330002: Holy 31 (Spiritual Focus 5, Divine Strength 3, Healing Light 3, Reverence 2, Divine Favor, Illumination 5, Infusion of Light 2, Oath of Light, Holy Shock, Boundless Light 2, Holy Power 5, Light's Vigil), Divine Intellect 5, and Retribution 15 for Benediction 5 and Conviction 3 (and 7 points that heal nothing: Improved Judgement 2, Sanctified Judgement 3 and Pursuit of Justice 2). Each other build moves the points to Divine Strength and Improved Seals, which heal nothing. Carry, 500 iterations:

  • The Retribution side is for Benediction (10% off Holy Shock, Divine Favor and the Oath) and Conviction's 3% crit, which feeds Illumination, Infusion of Light and Holy Power. A deeper Holy build has no healing talent left to buy: 31 points take every Holy healing talent, and Light's Vigil (the 31st) is only the capstone the presets don't cast (their Vigil variant was noise).

title: Holy Power's reading
html: Holy Power's reading. The tooltip says "Increases the critical strike healing bonus of your Holy spells by 10/20/30/40/50%"; the client's aura is 50 (critical healing amount), which in the 1.12 and TBC servers multiplies the whole critical heal. Default: a crit heals 150% x 1.5 = 225% at 5/5 (the aura's way, and the racials' precedent in notes.md). Alternatives: the bonus +50 points (200%) or the bonus x1.5 (175%): Onyxia 300 s 0.897 and 0.896 against 0.922 (Holy Light 9 and 8, no mana line), the files' own lengths within 0.02.

title: Oath of Light's bonus
html: Oath of Light's bonus. "Up to" 400 / 115 / 230 at 60, a flat amount on the heal: it crits with it, takes no healing power, and a rank downranking cuts loses the same share of it (core.DownrankFactor). Alternative: the bonus scaled by the heal's coefficient, like healing power: Onyxia 300 s 0.869 against 0.922, -0.01 at the files' own lengths.

title: Illumination on Light's Vigil
html: Illumination on Light's Vigil: once a detonation (not once a healed player), 50% of the Vigil's base cost. No preset casts the Vigil.

title: Light's Vigil's refund
html: Light's Vigil's refund: the cast spell's second effect still stores 75 (the old 75% refund) but the hotfix's tooltip has none. Default: no refund. No preset casts the Vigil.

title: The gear lists
html: The gear lists: the cached Forever Holy guide's gear planner holds beta item ids no database has, so the synthetic set is priced from the Classic pre-raid list with the shaman's spell power and healing split (orchestration/gear_targets.md).

title: The 7 free points
html: The 7 free points. Holy 31, Divine Intellect 5, Benediction 5 and Conviction 3 leave 7 points, which the preset puts in Improved Judgement, Sanctified Judgement and Pursuit of Justice. They heal nothing, and neither does any other place for them, so they're the project's to move (run speed, say).

title: Champion of the Light
html: Champion of the Light adds spell power (heals too) although its aura (174) reads as spell damage only; no healer build reaches it (25 Retribution points), so no number moves.

title: The raid sim's placeholder talents
html: The raid sim's placeholder talents (StandardTalents in presets.ts, used by the raid sim's paladin slot) are unchanged: whether the raid sim's paladin heals is the raid sim's call.

title: Libram of Holy Alacrity
html: Libram of Holy Alacrity (228175): its buff has no effect rows in 70753, so it isn't added; a log or a Wowhead tooltip with numbers settles it.

title: Wild Growth's shape
html: Wild Growth's shape. Default: Wrath of the Lich King's front-loaded ticks (+6% to −6%, the same total). The alternative is 7 even ticks. It only moves overhealing.

title: Swiftmend's heal
html: Swiftmend's heal. Default: every tick of the consumed HoT including Nature's Splendor's (5 Rejuvenation ticks, 9 Regrowth ticks), at the HoT's snapshot base and healing power, with Swiftmend's own modifiers (Gift of Nature, Genesis) in place of the HoT's. Alternatives: 1.12's fixed 12 sec of Rejuvenation or 18 of Regrowth (4 and 6 ticks), and/or the HoT's own modifiers carried over (Improved Rejuvenation's 15% on a consumed Rejuvenation).

title: Which HoT Swiftmend takes
html: Which HoT Swiftmend takes with both up: the one with less time left (1.12 and later). Untested in Forever.

title: Improved Regrowth on the HoT's ticks
html: Improved Regrowth on the HoT's ticks. Default: yes, the 50% crit is the spell's, and Forever's HoT ticks crit on the spell's crit chance (every druid HoT has the "periodic can crit" bit). The alternative is the direct heal only.

title: Gift of Nature on Tranquility
html: Gift of Nature on Tranquility. Default: yes, 10%: its first effect names Tranquility, though Tranquility is periodic and that effect is the "all of the spell" kind. A strict reading (that kind of modifier reaches direct heals only) leaves Tranquility without it.

title: Omen of Clarity on heals
html: Omen of Clarity on heals. Default: a heal rolls at the sim's spell rate (2 procs a minute over its cast time, the 1.12 melee rate the Balance druid's spells use too), when it's cast. The client leaves the chance to the server.

title: Bloom can crit
html: Bloom can crit (the heal has no "can't crit" bit). Default yes.

title: Downranking
html: Downranking is no longer a call: the engine applies it to every ranked spell (user ruling 2026-11-04, sim/core/downrank.go). What it moved on the presets is under "Downranking on the presets" below.

title: The raid sim's Restoration druid placeholder
html: The raid sim's Restoration druid placeholder (sim/compsearch/presets.go) keeps its old talents; whether it takes the bench's build is the raid sim's (H6).

title: Launching the spec page
html: Launching the spec page (ui/core/launched_sims.ts) is the project's call; it stays unlaunched.

title: Tuning and the presets
html:
orchestration/tools/healers/druid_restoration_apl.py writes the two rotations from knobs and druid_restoration_req.py the bench requests from the shaman's (the same raid, buffs and consumes): Thicc Resto 05302001--5053025153113051, Windshaper Skyborne, the synthetic set. Carry on tools/healbench, screened at 400 to 500 iterations, the finalists and the table at 1,000, on master with client 70753 and the November 2 notes.

  • Tank healer (apls/tank_healer.apl.json, req/druid_restoration.json: ht=11,8,6 low=0.4 ht_scale=0.9):
    • Healing Touch bound at ranks 11, 8 and 6 beats 11, 10, 9 on every file (Onyxia 1.165 against 1.094, Vaelastrasz 0.695 against 0.617, 500 iterations) and 11, 8, 7 or 11, 8, 6, 5 (500: 1.159 and 1.147 on Onyxia).
    • The emergency line at 40% and Healing Touch at 90% of its heal against the 35% line at the full heal, at 1,000: Golemagg 1.648 / 1.618, Onyxia at 180 / 300 sec 1.087 / 1.065 and 1.063 / 1.046, Chromaggus 0.870 / 0.867, Onyxia 1.165 / 1.164; Ragnaros 0.517 / 0.526, Broodlord 0.731 / 0.740 and Vaelastrasz 0.688 / 0.693 the other way. Shipped for the long fights.
    • Lost or level: Nature's Swiftness at 25% (+0.02 Broodlord, -0.015 Vaelastrasz), Regrowth at half its heal, Swiftmend at half, the Innervate threshold (6,000 mana left at the end: the tank side isn't mana bound).
    • Talents (500): Heart of the Wild for Nature's Focus level (1.177 / 1.172 on Onyxia, 1.095 / 1.087 at 180 sec), all 51 in Restoration -0.08 on Onyxia, 46 with Genesis -0.06. Races: Night Elf and Tauren within 0.01 of the Windshaper, the High Order the same as it (its Read Leyline never goes up, since Innervate is never on cooldown at 60% mana; the generator's leyline knob is there for a build that is mana bound).
  • Raid healer (apls/raid_healer.apl.json, req/druid_restoration_raid.json: rj_scale=0.2 low=0.5):
    • Rejuvenation at the most hurt once it misses 20% of the HoT, with a 50% emergency line, against 30% and 35%, at 1,000: ahead on every file (Onyxia 0.711 / 0.679, Chromaggus 0.953 / 0.887, Ragnaros 1.240 / 1.181, Magmadar 1.605 / 1.456, Golemagg 2.021 / 1.877).
    • Lost or mixed (500): Rejuvenation at 10% (Ragnaros +0.03, Broodlord and Chromaggus -0.01), a second rank of Rejuvenation (Vaelastrasz +0.07, Chromaggus -0.05), Wild Growth at half or 1.5 times its HoT, no Regrowth, Tranquility at 40%, Nature's Swiftness; Heart of the Wild or all 51 in Restoration lose up to 0.05.
    • It overheals about 60% (HPS 950, effective 370 on Onyxia): Wild Growth's other four targets and HoTs on players the next heal tops up. It still isn't mana bound (3,700 to 6,000 left).

Against the Restoration shaman (1,000 iterations, carry)

On the tank side the shaman's new Riptide put it ahead on the short fights (Broodlord +0.106, Magmadar +0.099, Vaelastrasz +0.087); the druid stays ahead on Onyxia and on the long fights (+0.077 and +0.094 at 180 and 300 sec). Before the shaman's change (master 3d1cb9701) the druid was ahead on every tank row (shaman Onyxia 1.017, Broodlord 0.618, Vaelastrasz 0.648, Chromaggus 0.764) and behind on four raid rows.

Downranking on the presets

The engine applies Forever's downranking to the druid's heals now (8f304b240, b57f5cc0a). This branch had the same rule in the druid package before (so the tuning above already had it); measured against the heals at their full coefficients (the scope without heals, ForeverDownrankScope = DownrankDamage, the round 3 rotations), 1,000 iterations:

  • The raid healer casts only ranks learned at 50 or later (Rejuvenation 11, Regrowth 9, Healing Touch 11 and 9, Wild Growth 3), which keep their whole coefficient, so nothing moves.
  • The tank healer's Healing Touch 6 (learned at 32) keeps 45% of its coefficient. Without the penalty it heals about 650 more, close to rank 8, so the ladder of 11, 8 and 6 loses its small step: the rank 6 line fires less, rank 11 more, and the carry drops by 0.005 to 0.075. A rotation tuned without the penalty would bind other ranks; this one was tuned with it, so the "without" column is a lower bound on what the rule costs.

The shared change

sim/core/apl_helpers.go (GetAPLDot): a dot or HoT check aimed at Most Hurt or Lowest Health finds the HoT through HealthUnit() instead of Get(), which is nil while the rotation is built (nobody is hurt yet). For a spell whose HoT is a Hot (no Dot), CurDot() was nil too, so the check was dropped from the condition (TestDruidHotAtMostHurt). The Restoration shaman's raid rotation has one such check (Riptide 1239243 not active at the most hurt). Its raid request at 1,000 iterations on all seven boss files, healbench built from this branch with and without the change: the same to the third decimal on every file (Magmadar 1.540, Golemagg 1.913, Ragnaros 1.171, Onyxia 0.678, Broodlord 0.817, Vaelastrasz 1.110, Chromaggus 0.906; mean 1.162 both ways). The same held on the shaman's rotation before 41aa10700.

title: Presets
html:
The bench (tools/healbench), one healer, each row at its own length; 500 iterations to screen and 1,000 for the finalists and the tables below. "Master" is origin/master 3d1cb9701 before this branch, which is H2's to the third decimal.

The bench drop after the 11-03 merge was the bench, not the sim. The shared scratchpad/healbench binary was rebuilt at 09:32 from another healer's branch (same size and time as its builds), which has none of Riptide's ranks 2 and 3, so the requests' Riptide (1239243) never cast. Built from this branch into a folder of its own, nothing dropped, and master's own build gives H2's numbers (Onyxia tank 1.017, Golemagg raid 2.083, Vaelastrasz raid 1.199, Vaelastrasz tank 0.648).

Talents. Improved Ghost Wolf left the tree's reach, so the 5 Enhancement points go to Ancestral Knowledge 5 and the 3 left to Thundering Strikes 3 (1% heal crit a point; Guardian Totems and Improved Lightning Shield do nothing for a healer). Restoration is H2's.

The tank healer gains two lines, the brief's gap check (bigger ranks, Riptide's 12 sec, Lesser Healing Wave, Nature's Swiftness):

  • Lesser Healing Wave 6 and 5 at the tank, bound, while mana is at least 50%, right after Riptide: more healing a second than Healing Wave for a little more a mana. Floors: 0% 1.035 (runs dry at 300 sec: 0.879), 50% 1.065, 60% 1.059, 70% 1.051, 80% 1.029; rank 6 alone at 70% 1.038 (the 0.959 base had none).
  • Nature's Swiftness when the tank is under 50% health, before Riptide (the bound Healing Wave 10 follows it): +0.011 alone, +0.005 with the Lesser Healing Wave lines (50% and 40%: within 0.004; 35%: -0.010).
  • Kept: Healing Wave ranks bound by what the tank misses (casting 10 at 75% of its heal: -0.008), Mana Tide at its floor (20% and 50%: within 0.001), Water Shield whenever its globes are spent (below 60% mana only: +0.003, but it loses both long Onyxia rows).

The raid healer is H2's APL on the notes' Riptide. Mana Tide's and Water Shield's mana floors never bind on the bench (Mana Tide 50%, Water Shield below 40% or 80%: the same numbers to the third decimal; the fights end first), which is why the 11-03 threshold runs were all equal. Riptide on the tank instead of the most hurt (-0.007) and Lesser Healing Wave 6 at the most hurt above 70% mana (-0.013) lose.

What the notes' Riptide costs, against the same presets on the client's Riptide (11-03 runs): about -0.07 on the raid healer (1.196 to 1.123: no instant heal on the most hurt, half as often) and about -0.035 on the tank healer with H2's APL (0.990 to 0.955). The new tank lines more than make it up there; nothing does on the raid healer, so its drop from master is the notes' and stays.

The gap to the Holy priest on the tank is the class's. The shaman now passes the paladin on every boss but Ragnaros (equal) and stays 0.06 to 0.29 below the priest. No rank, mana gate or cooldown use on the bench closes it: the best lines above are within 0.006 of each other.

title: The notes' Riptide
html: The notes' Riptide (standards 37). Default: modelled under Forever (no instant heal, 12 sec, 147 / 180 / 231 mana). The client's instead: about +0.07 raid healer mean carry and +0.035 tank healer (H2's tank APL).

title: Riptide's Chain Heal bonus on the whole chain
html: Riptide's Chain Heal bonus on the whole chain. The client's effect is a dummy, and the tooltip's "your Chain Heal casts directly on that target" says which casts, not which jumps. Default: the whole chain of a Chain Heal cast at a target with our Riptide. The first target only: the same tank numbers, the raid healer within 0.02 a row (e.g. Magmadar 1.621 against 1.639, the raid profile 0.909 against 0.900, on the client's Riptide).

title: Tidal Totem on the tank healer
html: Tidal Totem on the tank healer. Default: not in the preset's gear. With it: Golemagg +0.036, the other rows within 0.005 (on the client's Riptide).

title: The raid healer's Enhancement points
html: The raid healer's Enhancement points. Default: -035 (Thundering Strikes 3), as the tank healer. H2's -005102 (still legal, and what sim/compsearch/presets.go and ui/raid_sim/data/table.json give a raid member): +0.003 mean, within noise.

title: The presets
html:
Three builds, all on the healing priest synthetic set (990501 to 990514, the healing priest row of orchestration/gear_targets.md), the Restoration shaman's consumables, raid buffs and debuffs, and level 60:

The rotations are written by orchestration/tools/healers/priest_tuning/rots.py (run presets.sh from the repo root; it also writes tools/healbench/req/priest_holy.json, priest_holy_raid.json and priest_discipline.json, which are the shaman's request with the priest in its slot). Every rotation casts Flash Heal 7 at whoever in its assignment drops under the emergency line, Power Infusion on the priest when a big heal is due, Inner Focus right before the biggest heal, and binds at most 4 ranks of a heal, each cast once what's missing covers its Expected Healing.

  • Holy tank: Prayer of Mending and Renew on the tank whenever they're off, Flash Heal 7 and 4 first while mana is over 70%, then Greater Heal 5, 4, 2 and Flash Heal 7, 4.
  • Holy raid: Prayer of Mending at the most hurt whenever it's ready, a shield on whoever drops under 60%, then at the most hurt Flash Heal 7, 4, Prayer of Healing 5, Renew (once what's missing covers 60% of it) and Greater Heal 5, 2.
  • Discipline tank: Power Word: Shield whenever Weakened Soul is off the tank (under 50% mana only once what's missing covers a Greater Heal 5), Penance once what's missing covers its 3 bolts, Renew, then the Holy tank healer's Flash Heal and Greater Heal.

title: Divine Aegis: add to the shield or replace it
html: Divine Aegis: add to the shield or replace it. A new crit tops the shield up to the limit (20 a level), as the tooltip's "up to" reads. Replacing it would make it a little weaker on a tank hit by bursts.

title: Litany of Light: the fight's first heal counts, and "another heal" is by name
html: Litany of Light: the fight's first heal counts, and "another heal" is by name. Two ranks of Greater Heal are the same heal and give nothing back; Greater Heal after Flash Heal gives 5/10% back.

title: Prayer of Healing is weak under Forever
html: Prayer of Healing is weak under Forever (its ranks are the client's: 70753 kept them) and the raid rotation casts it after Flash Heal. Default: as the client.

title: The gear is a mix
html: The gear is a mix. The Forever priest guides list no items yet, so the synthetic set averages Wowhead's Classic healing priest pre-raid list with the Forever Restoration shaman list (gear_targets.md). Default: that mix, until a Forever priest list exists.

title: Shadowfiend and Lightwell aren't in Forever's priest
html: Shadowfiend and Lightwell aren't in Forever's priest (client 70753 has neither talent nor rank), so the sim has neither. Spirit of Redemption isn't simulated (a dead priest heals).

title: A shield's rest at the fight's end is booked as nothing
html: A shield's rest at the fight's end is booked as nothing, neither healing nor overheal, since the fight cut it off rather than the shield going to waste. Default: unbooked.

title: Prayer of Mending jumps on a hit that does damage after shields
html: Prayer of Mending jumps on a hit that does damage after shields. A hit a Power Word: Shield absorbs whole doesn't trigger it, as in game for an absorbed hit ("Absorbed" isn't damage taken).

title: Renewed Hope without Binding Heal
html: Renewed Hope without Binding Heal. The notes removed Binding Heal; Renewed Hope keeps its client spells (Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance on a Weakened Soul target).

title: Holy Nova heals the party but deals no damage
html: Holy Nova heals the party but deals no damage: its damage on enemies within 10 yards is left out, as a healer stands back, and everyone in the party counts as in reach. None of the three rotations casts it.

title: Spirit is 10% of the set's stat budget (standards 5), not the Classic priest list's 13%
html: Spirit is 10% of the set's stat budget (standards 5), not the Classic priest list's 13%. A priest heals off Spirit more than a shaman (Meditation, Spiritual Guidance), so the cap costs it some regen and healing. Default: 10%, as every set.

title: Discipline is weaker than Holy at tank healing
html: Discipline is weaker than Holy at tank healing on all 7 boss files (The presets, above): Penance and the shield don't make up for Holy's Prayer of Mending, Spiritual Healing and Holy Binding. The default build is Holy, Discipline is a preset.

title: Notes-only values
html: Notes-only values. Two of the healing rules come from Blizzard's notes, not the client (standards 37): a Power Word: Shield can be replaced by an equal or higher rank (ExtraCastCondition, test TestHealingPriestShieldReplaceRank), and Binding Heal is removed (client 70753 still has its rows). Both are listed under "Notes-only values" in orchestration/round_70753/priest.md.

title: The priest's tank healers carry a lot more than the shaman's
html: The priest's tank healers carry a lot more than the shaman's (0.11 to 0.65 more on all 7 files), much more than its raid healer does. The priest's numbers are its client values; the gap may say as much about the shaman's tank preset (Healing Wave at 12% overheal, a lot of mana left) as about the priest. Default: as benched, for the shaman session to look at.

title: Spec stays unlaunched
html: Spec stays unlaunched (the brief): ui/healing_priest builds, but isn't in the spec list.
